title: Victorinox Huntsman Pocket Knife — 15 Functions, Swiss Made
short_description: A classic Swiss pocket knife with 15 functions: blade, scissors, wood saw, corkscrew and more. 91 mm, only 97 g, red — Swiss Made quality.
long_description: The Victorinox Huntsman is a legendary Swiss pocket knife with 15 functions. It combines the functions of the classic Officer's Knife and adds scissors and a wood saw. It includes a large and small blade, corkscrew, can opener, screwdriver, bottle opener, reamer, tweezers and toothpick, among others. At just 91 mm long and 97 g, it fits in any pocket. The handle scales are made of robust ABS/Cellidor and the steel is stainless. Ideal for camping, hiking, outdoors and daily use.
features: 15 functions (blade, scissors, wood saw and more)
